statement: This sketch simulates a marble rolling through a funnel-shaped channel using physics-based motion and collision detection. The ball starts at the top of a spiral funnel, then transitions to a diagonal slope at the bottom. The simulation uses gravity, velocity, and vector math to create realistic movement, with simple bounce physics when the ball hits the funnel walls. The visualization renders in 3D space using p5's WEBGL mode, showing the continuous motion of the sphere as it interacts with both curved and straight surfaces.
